name: Base
description: Creates the vscode user, installs common dependencies, configures Oh-My-Zsh

username.description: Specify container username, if not vscode.

userUid.description: Specify container user's UID, if not 1000

userGid.description: Specify container user's GID, if not 1000

installZsh.description: Whether to install the ZSH shell and set it as default shell.

installOMZ.description: Whether to install Oh-My-Zsh and configure the user's .zshrc. Requires installZsh.

omzTheme.description: Specify the Oh-My-Zsh theme name to use, if not agnoster.
